entities.name: Gate
entities.description: A nonbasic land type for cards representing guarded entrances to cities or castles, introduced in the Return to Ravnica block.

entities.name: Guildgates
entities.description: The original ten Gates representing each of the Ravnican guilds.

entities.name: Gateway Plaza
entities.description: The 11th Gate, representing the plaza connecting the Guildgates where the Chamber of the Guildpact stands.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: Hall that stands at Gateway Plaza.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane whose guilds the Guildgates represent.

entities.name: Baldur's Gate
entities.description: City represented by a legendary Gate in Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact whose rebirth appears in the hidden Gate message.

events.summary: Gate is added as a new land subtype to the common dual-land cycle in Return to Ravnica so they could have a secondary mechanical purpose.
events.quote: The solution to this problem was to add a new land subtype, Gate, to the common dual land cycle.

relations.quote: The original ten Gates are the Guildgates, representing each of the Ravnican guilds .
